name: Dripify
description: Dripify is a cloud sales-automation platform for LinkedIn and email outreach sequences, lead enrichment, email discovery and verification, inbox management, campaign analytics, and team workflows.
agentUseSummary: Dripify documents a cloud web application and outbound campaign webhooks that transfer lead data, but it does not publish a supported third-party API for controlling campaigns or reading a customer workspace. Relay therefore does not capture Dripify or LinkedIn login credentials, automate the private web app, ingest prospect webhooks, or expose agent actions.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is offered until Dripify publishes a supported, contract-compatible third-party workspace API.

runtimeSupport.description: No contract-compatible bounded Relay connector is available.
No contract-compatible bounded Relay connector is available.

providerSetup.blocker: Dripify does not publish a third-party API for controlling campaigns or reading a customer workspace; its documented integration is outbound campaign webhook delivery containing lead data.
providerSetup.nextAction: Reassess only if Dripify publishes a stable third-party API with explicit authentication, permissions, schemas, distribution terms, revocation, and bounded non-outreach reads suitable for Relay.

evidence.supports: Official product material describes cloud LinkedIn/email automation, enrichment, inboxes, analytics, teams, native integrations, and webhooks, but no public developer API or authorization contract.
Official support identifies Dripify as a cloud web application operated through its control panel.
Official support documents outbound HTTP POST webhooks configured inside campaigns and states that lead data is transferred through those webhooks; this is not a third-party workspace API.
Official privacy terms describe a subscription web application that automates LinkedIn processes and stores customer-managed prospect and marketing data.
Official customer terms govern the subscription service but do not publish Relay-compatible developer authentication, permissions, or API distribution terms.
